title: Brendan Sorsby will not pursue path to NFL in 2026, QB to prepare for 2027 draft

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Brendan Sorsby will not pursue path to NFL in 2026, QB to prepare for 2027 draft
sources.description: Sorsby won't be pursuing litigation against the NFL in an attempt to play in 2026, and he'll be eligible for the 2027 draft
